Measuring 10 inches in diameter (approximately 25.4 cm) and featuring 60 finely crafted teeth, this blade delivers smooth, accurate cuts across a wide range of materials including wood, plywood, laminates, and more. The Tungsten Carbide Tipped (TCT) construction ensures exceptional durability and long-lasting sharpness, even under demanding working conditions. The 60-tooth configuration makes it ideal for fine, clean cuts with minimal splintering or tear-out, making it a preferred choice for carpenters, woodworkers, and construction professionals alike. Whether you are working on furniture, flooring, or general carpentry projects, this saw blade provides the reliability and precision you need. Compatible with most standard circular saws and table saws, it is a versatile addition to any toolkit. Trust Xtra Power to deliver consistent performance on every job site.
